remarks: Welcome to this warm and cozy 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo unit in the Cove area. The layout works perfectly with the living room flowing into the dining area and then into the kitchen. You will love the shiny hardwood floors, the high ceiling, central air and having your own laundry right in the laundry. The location is super convenient. It's just minutes away from restaurants, shopping schools, place or worship, public transportation and the train station. Storage in the lower level and convenient off street parking. Perfect for a first time homebuyers or investors. Sale is as is. Go see it today!!!
